topography.project_purpose: Ledgity Yield is a multi-chain yield protocol that issues yield-bearing stablecoin tokens (LTokens) backed by real-world assets and DeFi strategies. Users can deposit stablecoins to receive LTokens, stake them for additional rewards, and participate in vaults that optimize yield across chains.
topography.relationship_narrative: LTokens rely on Yield Vaults for yield generation and on Staking contracts for reward distribution. All families share a common governance and access control layer (GlobalAccessList, GlobalBlacklist, GlobalPause, GlobalOwner) that enforces security and administrative policies across chains.
